# Wallpaper*

> > Wallpaper* is a global authority on design, architecture, art, fashion, travel, and lifestyle, delivering curated coverage of contemporary culture and creative innovation.

Founded as a design and lifestyle magazine, Wallpaper* features expert commentary from contributors including Jonathan Bell, Tianna Williams, Sofia de la Cruz, and Hannah Silver. The publication covers everything from residential architecture and contemporary art exhibitions to fashion week reviews and luxury hospitality destinations.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary art
- Residential architecture
- Interior design
- Fashion Week A/W 2026
- Gallery exhibitions
- Luxury hospitality
- Design innovation
- Aviation architecture
- Custom furniture
- Vintage design
- London design scene
- Paris Fashion Week
- Modernist design
- Sustainable architecture
- Design-led workspaces
